content:
I am organizing a one-day workshop about Lean in Lyon (France) on May 10th, 2022. There will be five talks by @Riccardo Brasca , @Johan Commelin , @Floris van Doorn , @Sebastien Gouezel and @Patrick Massot . The talks will be streamed on Zoom and probably recorded, but anyone is welcome to come in person!
https://www.univ-st-etienne.fr/lean-in-lyon.html
Please forward and repost!
poster.jpg
Will the talks be in French or in English?

I guess two speakers will certainly speak in English, the French speakers can choose what they prefer (but if a lot of non-French participants are connected, or in the room, I would encourage them to speak in English).
Despite the definitive interest of this event, it is regrettable that the speakers are only men…
Will the slides or videos be posted?
Here are my slides. The vides have been recorded, so I guess they will be posted (@Filippo A. E. Nuccio if you need some kind of consent let me know, but do whatever you want :))
Yes, they will as soon as I gather all consents and I discuss with whom is in charge with the youtube channel.
Here are my slides (@Filippo A. E. Nuccio feel free to repost/link to them if you want).
